Question 20

The line y=2x−4 intercepts the x- and y-axes at points A and B, respectively. If the segment AB― is a diameter of a circle, find the equation of the circle.

a
(x−1)2+(y+2)2=5
b
(x−1)2+(y+2)2=5
c
(x−2)2+(y+4)2=5
d
(x−2)2+(y+2)2=5
e
(x−2)2+(y+4)2=10
